subject.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications

question: Should RFC 0009 make the proposed signed snapshot/query/delta and client-first watch behaviors the normative Hosted Feed v1 public contract before the linked OpenClaw and ClawHub implementations merge?
rationale: This determines a cross-repository compatibility and trust contract; implementation quality alone cannot establish whether these public v1 commitments are the intended product boundary.

options.title: Approve after interoperability review
options.body: Confirm the proposed v1 contract after reviewing a real OpenClaw–ClawHub interoperability demonstration and the linked implementation PRs.

options.title: Narrow or defer optional tracks
options.body: Keep the core publisher-feed contract and defer query, delta, hosted-sync, or inbox commitments until their implementations and upgrade behavior are independently validated.

recommendation.title: Approve after interoperability review
recommendation.body: Confirm the proposed v1 contract after reviewing a real OpenClaw–ClawHub interoperability demonstration and the linked implementation PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: Current RFC attribution makes Vincent the best available routing candidate for the baseline protocol direction.
